units.source_text: 闲愁万种无可排遣之时，忽逢来使殷勤慰问，

en.t: At a time when countless idle sorrows could not be dispelled, a messenger suddenly arrived with kind and attentive words of concern,
although her heart was grateful, her circumstances were truly desperate.

units.source_text: 务请早日善为处置，以图日后安身之计。”

en.t: Please make proper arrangements as soon as possible, so that I may have some means of securing my life in the days to come."
